MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE l.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey)+collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS ks
WITH i,pr,[k IN ks WHERE k IS NOT NULL AND k<>''] AS ks
UNWIND ks AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS ps WHERE size(ps)>=2
UNWIND ps AS id
RETURN DISTINCT id, 'person' AS kind
UNION
MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE l.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey)+collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS ks
WITH i,pr,[k IN ks WHERE k IS NOT NULL AND k<>''] AS ks
UNWIND ks AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS ps WHERE size(ps)>=2
RETURN DISTINCT pr.projectKey AS id, 'project' AS kind
